nodes.label: Part Profile Contract
nodes.rationale: Output contract of Phase 1 and the interface to Phases 2/3: part_number, part_name, canonical L>=B>=H mm, weight kg, source manual|stp, confirmed_orientation (4x4) and glb_path stored for Phase 3. Extend additively; never rename fields.

nodes.label: Min-Volume OBB Dimension Basis
nodes.rationale: Auto OEM STEP files arrive in vehicle coordinates, so axis-aligned boxes are wrong. Min-volume OBB of the convex hull is orientation-independent and solves the unknown-plane problem; dims stay reliable even for non-watertight geometry.

nodes.label: Candidate Orientations + User Confirmation
nodes.rationale: Full automation of resting orientation is unreliable; a 2-second human confirmation kills the error class. Dims are auto-filled but always editable, never silently accepted.

nodes.label: GLB Metres-to-mm Scaling Contract
nodes.rationale: glTF spec is metres; backend load_unified_mesh scales mesh x1000 to mm for math, frontend OrientationViewer scales model x1000. The two sides MUST stay in sync; never change the scaling in only one place.

nodes.label: Z-up Backend vs Y-up Three.js Basis Swap
nodes.rationale: Backend orientation matrices are Z-up, mapping mesh space to resting pose on the z=0 floor (OBB-centered). Three.js scenes are Y-up, so every view wraps with a rotateX(-pi/2) basis swap kept as a single definition. Phase 3 depends on these semantics; do not change silently.

nodes.label: Celery + Redis Async Extraction
nodes.rationale: STEP conversion is 2-30s CPU-bound; it must never run in the request cycle. Celery workers scale horizontally; nothing CPU-bound in FastAPI handlers.

nodes.label: Phase 3: Insert Generation
nodes.rationale: Classify part into archetype: comb/slot dunnage for tube-like (aspect ratio >5:1), pocket/cell with divider walls for compact prismatic, else hybrid tray. Consumes confirmed_orientation and glb_path stored on the Part Profile so the user is never re-asked.

edges.source_location: confirmed_orientation and glb_path stored for Phase 3
Gotcha #6: Phase 3 depends on the coordinate frame; don't change silently
